title: Key features of sine, cosine, and tangent graphs

sections.heading: Core Concepts: Key features of sine, cosine, and tangent graphs

questions.q: For the model $f(x) = 2x + 7$ in key features of sine, cosine, and tangent graphs, evaluate $f(2)$.
Find the positive solutions to the quadratic equation $x^2 - 4x + 3 = 0$.
A data set recorded for key features of sine, cosine, and tangent graphs consists of the four values $\{16, 20, 24, 30\}$. What is the arithmetic mean?
questions.answer: The sum is $16 + 20 + 24 + 30 = 90$, and dividing by $4$ gives $22.5$.
